game_concept: A survival strategy set in Sand Dunes – Cactus Flats, flats of tall cacti: the sand ranger must handle dust devils while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Refactor Rescue: Clean up messy duplicated code into tidy functions without changing its behavior.
theme: Sand Dunes – Cactus Flats: flats of tall cacti
core_gameplay_loop: In Cactus Flats, repeat each round: Clean up messy duplicated code into tidy functions without changing its behavior. Each round, dust devils strike the bazaar gate, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the clean_score value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the bazaar gate from dust devils in Cactus Flats: keep the clean_score meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 71-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: clean_score drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 71-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 8 (extended tier): Refactor Rescue
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Refactor Rescue' (Week 9 slot 8), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Cactus Flats'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how clean_score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against dust devils in Cactus Flats.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 71 seconds while clean_score > 0.
